hypothesis: Reusing one verified Hyperliquid REST completed-minute candle snapshot per symbol can materially reduce V58 shared-IP request weight without changing completed-bar OHLCV, route decisions, or completed-bar exit decisions.
decision: Continue the cached-observer versus uncached-live parity window and archive-only WebSocket collection. Do not modify or restart the live backend. Direct WebSocket substitution remains rejected because the sealed source-parity result contains decision mismatches. Present a separate live-cache implementation request only after the 24-hour OHLCV and exact controller-decision gates pass.
falsifier: Reject or revise the live-cache challenger if any cached-versus-uncached completed-bar difference changes a V58 route or profit-lock decision, a missing completed bar is cached, the request reduction is below 70 percent, or 429 and cycle-latency behavior does not materially improve.
limitations: The current parity prefix covers 200 completed minutes per asset, not the predeclared 24-hour window.
Live telemetry preserves accepted completed bars but does not serialize every redundant REST response.
Zero OHLCV mismatch does not prove that a very late venue revision can never occur.
Exact candle parity must still be propagated through route, entry-freshness, maximum-hold, opposite-exit, and profit-lock decision parity.
Shared-IP aggregate request weight is inferred from code paths and failures; a centralized measured per-endpoint request trace is not yet available.
No profitability conclusion follows from transport reliability evidence.

problem_restatement.input: The V58 live backend, observer, checkpoint, venue preflight, index-pressure observers, and lifecycle watchers share the venue public-info rate budget.
problem_restatement.observed_failure: Intermittent HTTP 429 responses skip otherwise recoverable public-data or reconciliation cycles.
problem_restatement.required_output: Reduce avoidable public-info weight without changing candle values, route decisions, profit-lock decisions, live authority, risk, or exit policy.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: A same-source request-reuse challenger demonstrates exact completed-bar and decision parity while materially reducing candleSnapshot calls.

venue_documented_limits.candleSnapshot_additional_weight_note: Additional weight applies per 60 returned items.
venue_documented_limits.websocket_guidance: The venue recommends WebSockets for lowest-latency real-time data.

index_observer_call_contract.interpretation: The two index observers alone are well below the documented aggregate limit; shared-IP aggregate traffic remains the relevant boundary.

limitations: The live telemetry records first accepted completed-bar values, not every redundant REST response.
Zero OHLCV mismatch does not independently prove that a very late venue revision can never occur.
The current prefix is shorter than the predeclared 24-hour acceptance target.
Exact candle parity alone does not prove profit-lock decision parity for every possible path.

websocket_challenger.direct_cutover_blocker: The sealed V51 source-parity result found four SP500 and two SPCX signal-decision mismatches between REST/candleSnapshot and WebSocket/public-trade mechanisms.

analysis.likely_cause: Aggregate shared-IP request weight, especially repeated candleSnapshot traffic and concurrent account/preflight reads, is a more plausible cause than the two five-second index L2 observers alone.
analysis.cause_falsifier: A measured aggregate request-weight trace below the venue limit during a new 429 burst would falsify simple aggregate-weight saturation and require investigation of burst, endpoint-specific, or upstream limits.
analysis.capital_impact: No recorded eligible entry or order was lost after the identified V58 degraded cycles, but a future boundary could be affected and account reconciliation latency is operationally undesirable.
analysis.capital_impact_falsifier: Any eligible completed-bar signal whose valid submission window expires solely because of a 429, or any protection/reconciliation action delayed by a 429, establishes material impact.

recommendation.recommendation: Continue archive-only WebSocket evidence and prepare, but do not deploy, a same-source live completed-minute candle cache challenger after the 24-hour parity gate.
recommendation.why_now: V58 has recorded recoverable 429 cycles, while the report-only cache already reduced candle requests and produced exact same-source OHLCV parity across the current prefix.
recommendation.observed_problem_or_opportunity: Repeated same-minute candleSnapshot requests consume high-weight public-info budget without producing new completed-bar decisions.
recommendation.applicable_market_regime: All regimes; this is transport efficiency rather than a market-direction rule.
recommendation.proposed_live_change: Pending validation and separate approval, wrap the live cohort candle fetcher in completed-minute request reuse using the existing Hyperliquid REST candle source. Do not change strategy, route, sizing, leverage, stop, target, or exit policies.
recommendation.expected_upside: Approximately 75 percent fewer steady-state live candleSnapshot calls at a 15-second poll interval, leaving more shared-IP headroom and reducing the probability of skipped cycles.
main_risks: A venue revision after the first accepted completed-bar response could be hidden until the next minute.
A profit-lock path could differ if cached and later uncached OHLCV differ.
Reduced calls may not eliminate 429s caused by other processes or burst limits.
A future restart would load changed implementation code and therefore requires explicit review and authorization.
validation_completed: Existing cache unit tests cover same-minute reuse, next-minute refresh, deep-copy isolation, and retry when the completed bar is missing.
The current cached-observer versus uncached-live prefix has 1600/1600 exact OHLCV matches.
Every current live degraded cycle recovered with complete route coverage and no eligible signal.
Two archive-only WebSocket evidence sessions started without stream gaps or execution authority.
validation_still_required: Reach at least 24 contiguous hours and 11520 exact OHLCV overlap rows across eight assets with zero unexplained mismatch.
Replay cached and uncached inputs through exact V58 route and completed-bar profit-lock controllers and require identical decisions.
Measure request-count and cycle-latency reduction in an authority-none process.
Run focused tests plus the complete non-network Python suite.
Require a verified flat and order-free restart boundary or an explicitly reviewed open-position restart-adoption plan before any deployment.
success_metrics: At least 70 percent fewer steady-state live candleSnapshot calls.
Zero completed-bar OHLCV mismatch across the acceptance window.
Zero route, entry-freshness, maximum-hold, opposite-exit, or profit-lock decision mismatch.
No increase in poll latency, stale intent, runtime fault, or unprotected-position events.
No execution authority in any challenger process.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any cached-versus-uncached OHLCV mismatch changes a V58 decision.
Any profit-lock action differs by side, timestamp, price, or lifecycle identity.
Any missing completed bar is cached rather than retried.
429 frequency or cycle latency does not materially improve.
Any direct WebSocket substitution changes the frozen REST signal mechanism.
recommendation.explicit_approval_requested: No live cutover approval requested yet. Continue report-only collection. After the 24-hour parity and controller-decision gates pass, present a separate approval-ready implementation and deployment request.
